_comment: 2HG (opponent_heads 2): Crackle with Power can target BOTH opposing heads, and both drain the
one shared team pool -- so 5X lands twice. At X=3 that is 15+15 = 30, exactly the team's start,
a lethal the single-face model cannot see (5X >= 30 alone needs X=6). The companion fixture
hinata_crackle_2hg_off.json runs the IDENTICAL board without opponent_heads and asserts no win,
so the pair isolates the second head as the only difference.
Mana: X=3 with Hinata out and the lethal declared count (cap=2: second head + self) discounts
min(X, 1+2)=3, so the cast costs {X=9}+{R}{R}-3 = 8 of the 9 Mountains. The declared extras
are the second head (15 to the team) and SELF (15, non-lethal at 20 life) -- the by-design
max-discount-on-the-win-turn line -- hence expect_active_life 5. Hinata's 4-power swing is
surplus overkill on top of the 30 (the run turn's untap step clears any staged tapped/sick,
so the attack cannot be fixtured away); the WIN needs the second head's 15.
